See scripts/audit-platform-capabilities.ts. pathImports/pathFiles are 0 on purpose — no retained node's platform.ts imports node:path any more. hiddenFiles/hiddenEdges count builtins reached THROUGH a shared workspace package along the graph the realm actually loads: a specifier listed in HOST_SERVED_PACKAGES is followed into its service module, so config's node face and czkawka-native are no longer charged to the nodes that import them. hiddenByPackage is the work list itself: a package's number reaching 0 is what frees the builtin shim it was the last to use — and for a package whose specifier is answered by a HOST_SERVED_PACKAGES alias, that alias stays, because it is what answers the node rather than what the node leaks. The three entries are the remaining scope of the migration (no node-level work left); a fourth package appearing here is a new undeclared machine dependency, not progress. config 1 is node:os from paths.ts (the default platform arm), file-operations 1 and logging 2 are the shared-package edges that need host-op answers.
